EZMB_TEMPORARY.title: Temporary
EZMB_TEMPORARY.description: This card only exists during this combat. It is removed after combat ends.
EZMB_PLANTED.title: Plant
EZMB_PLANTED.description:
Planting is [gold]Seedbed[/gold]'s intercept rule: before an eligible card enters your hand, Seedbed removes it from this combat and gives you [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Withered Husk[/gold].
Planting does not count as play, discard, or [gold]Exhaust[/gold], and it triggers none of those payoffs. Temporary Status and Curse cards disappear after combat; permanent Curses are not permanently deleted.
- [gold]Blight Sprout[/gold]: does not count as played, but counts as handled for this combat; it does not enter hand, does not grow, and adds no [gold]Rootblight I[/gold].
- [gold]Rootblight[/gold]: pauses this combat's end check; it does not cleanse, downgrade, worsen, or split, and keeps the same stage after combat.
- Strength: Seedbed gives Block now, prevents one pollution draw, and gives [blue]1[/blue] Husk per plant. Each Husk later Exhausts for [blue]3[/blue] Block.
